Chords and Solfège

Play notes and see what they are: the chord name, its Roman numeral, and every note named in solfège, scale degrees or Sargam. The names move to whatever key you set, so the same chord reads the same in any key. Play on the keys below, on the letter keys of your computer, or on a MIDI keyboard.
